summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for building and completing the Appointment Category (Salon & Beauty) within Atrium ERP & CRM. Details the architecture for shared screens (Clients, Beauty Store, History, Staff & Finance, Registrations/Inquiries, and Dashboard) with strict facility data isolation, dynamic terminology adaptation, rich appointment history within the client slide-in inspector, full salon metrics on the dashboard, and 1-click POS checkout with stylist attribution.
